feeds.title: Art Class Curator Blog
feeds.description: Art Class Curator is dedicated to empowering you to embrace teaching art with works of art. Explore art teacher tips, discover new art and innovative art lessons to make art history and art appreciation fun for you and your students!

feeds.title: The Art of Ed
feeds.description: The Art of Ed is an online resource for art teachers providing online classes, teaching materials, lessons and videos. We grow amazing art teachers by providing rigorous, relevant and engaging learning at every stage of their career.

feeds.title: The Arty Teacher Blog
feeds.description: The Arty Teacher provides art resources to art teachers around the globe. Sharing good practice, fresh ideas and ideas saving teachers time.

feeds.title: Cassie Stephens Blog
feeds.description: An elementary art teacher blog with art projects and lessons, DIY projects and outfit photos as well as clothing I have made myself. Authored by Cassie Stephens.

feeds.title: Arte a Scuola
feeds.description: Miriam Paternoster is an Italian art teacher in a North Italian middle school. This blog is a forum for art teachers and schools all over the world to discuss and explore lessons, educational methods and approaches.

feeds.title: ARTBAR Blog
feeds.description: Bar Rucci will present the most innovative artists, curate the best crafts for the home and classroom and share creations from her children and studio at Art Bar. This blog is a place for her to share her passion of creative experiences as well as easy advice and ideas for bringing creativity into the lives of her readers.

feeds.title: Art With Mr. E
feeds.description: Art Education blog by Ted Daniel Edinger. Ted grew up in a small coal mining/farming town in southeastern Ohio. Though he didn't have art till high school, he was always interested in drawing, painting, quilts and crafts.

feeds.title: Deep Space Sparkle
feeds.description: Deep Space Sparkle is a blog devoted to helping adults teach art to kids. We make teaching art to kids easy by providing elementary art lesson plans, kid's art tutorials and creative teaching resources.

feeds.title: Art Ed Guru
feeds.description: Eric Gibbons is a highly qualified, award winning, NJ certified art teacher (28 years) with a second certification in elementary education. He is also a published author, speaker, publisher, award winning inventor, and gallery owner with more than 20 years of experience.

feeds.title: Erika Lancaster Blog
feeds.description: Drawing, watercolor and acrylic painting tips and tutorials. Erika is a traditional media artist and online teacher that's obsessed with creating and teaching art.

feeds.title: Teach art in the Montessori classroom Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Spramani Elaun, and I've discovered exactly how early childhood students to elementary grade students learn art naturally. I help Montessori Teachers teach kids art lessons.

feeds.title: Ms Artastic
feeds.description: I am Kathleen McGiveron and I am both the founder and creator of all things Ms Artastic. I am a one woman show that creates everything from the art lessons and resources, my blog, the Artastic Collective, my Podcast, & YouTube Channel. Find creative art lessons, art projects & art resources for teachers, art educators, and homeschool parents on my blog.

feeds.title: Inside Out Art Teacher Blog
feeds.description: I'm Lauren and I am here to help you and your students shine from the inside out. Find ideas for your next middle or high school art project or lesson. Resources to teach the elements and principles of art and make teaching art in high school fun.

feeds.title: MrsTFox Resources Blog
feeds.description: My name is Tiffany Fox, and I am a High School Visual Arts Teacher. My hope and my goal is to make this site a comfortable place where people can go to get quality, thorough and easy to use resources for the art classroom, homeschool platform, or personal art skill development.

feeds.title: U Ken Do Art
feeds.description: Everyone can do art. By that, I mean that anyone can learn to express themselves visually. Of course, this takes some encouragement along with a judgment-free environment. I have received encouragement over the years and am here to give some back. I want to share my favorite experiences in art, trips to art museums, lesson plans, and projects from classes I've taught. Even if you don't do art on a regular basis, you can still appreciate it and learn how to talk about it with others.

feeds.title: Art Projects for Kids Blog
feeds.description: A collection of fun and easy art projects that include hundreds of how-to-draw tutorials. Founder Kathy Barbro believes that simple step-by-step tutorials can do wonders to take the mystery out of drawing.

feeds.title: A Faithful Attempt
feeds.description: 'A Faithful Attempt' is designed to showcase a variety of K-12 art lessons, the work of my art students, as well as other art-related topics. Projects shown are my take on other art teacher's lessons, lessons found in books, or else designed by myself.

feeds.title: The artist and I
feeds.description: My name is Zaifeeda, and you can call me 'Feeda'. I am an art teacher at Tanarata International Schools Kajang in Selangor, Malaysia.

feeds.title: The Artful Parent
feeds.description: Jean Van't Hul is a writer, mother of two, and children's art enabler. The Artful Parent is the parent's resource for easy and fun kids art, family crafts, children's creativity, and process-oriented kids arts and crafts activities.

feeds.title: Painted Paper Art
feeds.description: This is the place to find posts of fun, exciting projects created by elementary students from a school in Ohio. Bright and colorful photos to springboard lessons for anyone who loves to paint with children.

feeds.title: 2 Soul Sisters
feeds.description: Kim and Karen's 2 Soul Sisters is a blog about art education and other art-related topics, displaying their creative journey as they put their heart and soul into teaching students and inspiring blog readers!

feeds.title: Argy's Point Of View
feeds.description: Argy Nestor is an art educator, blogger, artist, and connector. The purpose of this blog is to share stories that include innovative ideas, resources, and to celebrate the amazing work going on in Arts Education.

feeds.title: Eco Kids Art Blog
feeds.description: I'm Spramani Elaun. I help teachers and parents teach kids art.I share art teaching ideas, lessons, curriculum, resources and art training.

feeds.title: Create Art with ME
feeds.description: Create Art with ME is an art education blog by Michelle East (ME) that provides quality k-12 art lesson plans, projects, and classroom management resources for today's art teacher.

feeds.title: Art Teacher Smile
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Emily McEneely, art educator and advocate for the arts in everyone's life! My own artistic journey began, of course, as a child. Art was always my favorite activity although I wasn't necessarily big on traditional skills. The end goal always being to create vibrant, engaging lessons that spark the creative fire in my students. This blog reflects elementary visual arts education.

feeds.title: Pop Up Art School Blog
feeds.description: Engaging art activities for remote teaching and homeschooling. Best friends and business partners; Janell Scannell and Lisa Walker work and teach side-by-side in their business. Both have earned their BFA's and are certified art teachers for grades K to 8 in the state of Massachusetts. Pop up Art School has been in business for eight years and has taught over 500 classes in public libraries, plus afterschool enrichment in public and private schools.

feeds.title: Kerry Kirkpatrick
feeds.description: Kerry Kirkpatrick received her BFA in Digital Art at BGSU in 2016 and has been active since then in international and local arts communities. The blog is where you will find announcements and professional development tips. Most of her posts will be related to Digital Art and Alternative Print techniques.

feeds.title: There's a Dragon in my Art Room
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Phyl and after 36 years as an art teacher, I am now officially retired, but that doesn't mean I'm done with art education. The truth is, I'm more involved now than ever before! I share art lesson ideas, thoughts on art education, my own personal artistic and photographic endeavors, and tidbits about my family and the beautiful environment where we live.

feeds.title: All Smilez Blog
feeds.description: Art teacher Kim loves to help people learn to draw and paint. Sign up and Kim will keep you in the loop with ideas for keeping up with some art at home, online art lessons for kids and beginners, and more.

feeds.title: Create Art With Mrs. P!
feeds.description: I'm Mrs. P - a creative, loud, mother of four. This blog is a resource for educators and parents who wish to explore the world of art with the children in their lives. Have fun, create and learn something new--together! My lessons combine Art History, world cultures and a variety of media--I love all sorts of art and it all makes it into my lessons!

feeds.title: One Crayola Short
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Jodi. I have been teaching elementary art since 2004 and I love to share tips and ideas.

feeds.title: Alison Klein Blog
feeds.description: Art education blog by Alison Klein. As an art teacher, she looks to challenge students to keep looking... and get lost in the art experience for what it is... exciting, dynamic, and interconnected with our world.

feeds.title: Millis High School Art Blog
feeds.description: Carol Haggerty is a teacher of Visual Arts. At Millis High School, we use a blended learning approach in all art classes - offering a variety of methods and resources to engage student learning.

feeds.title: Rainforest Art Project Blog
feeds.description: Read articles by founder, Dan Evers, about the impact of art in schools and how the Rainforest Art Project is determined to make a difference in local communities. We want to encourage a new way of thinking, and broaden the younger generation's perspective of the world; art as a way of life, not only as an expression.

feeds.title: Studio 4 Art Blog
feeds.description: I'm Kebby the founder of Studio 4 Art. It's been 21 years of doing what I love, bringing the community together through creativity! Studio 4 art is a one place for all visual and hands-on art forms like sketching, drawing, craft and more! Read more about activities conducted by studios for people of all ages, art stories, history of different arts and more!

feeds.title: Just Your Everyday Art Teacher
feeds.description: A blog by a Texas art teacher Ashley Mills.

feeds.title: Americans For The Arts Blog
feeds.description: ARTSblog, the blog of Americans for the Arts, features posts on a variety of arts topics written by leading field experts. ARTSblog is a highly curated space for our staff, members, stakeholders, and constituents to share and learn from each other and gain the latest perspectives on everything in the arts field, from Arts Education to Public Art to Community Engagement through the arts and more. \

feeds.title: Meri Cherry Blog
feeds.description: Meri Cherry Blog is an arts and crafts blog for kids and their families. Articles on Art adventure, Design, Graphic Art, Process Art and holiday craft

feeds.title: Teach Kids Art Blog
feeds.description: I'm Cheryl, and I'm a great supporter of children's art. I spent over 20 years teaching art to children and it was the most rewarding job I've ever had! This diverse set of experiences has taught me a lot, and I'm happy to keep sharing what I've learned in order to assist others find success teaching art to children!

feeds.title: Adventures of an Art Teacher
feeds.description: Katie Morris is an art teacher and artist from Holton, KS. Katie's specialties are portraits, flowers, birds, and bugs.

feeds.title: ART CAMP Blog
feeds.description: ART CAMP is a virtual art studio and blog that inspires creativity and connection through art, craft and DIY experiences for the whole family.

feeds.title: iPad Art Room
feeds.description: Pad Art Room provides resources, ideas and insights for exciting learning experiences that merge traditional art-making processes with innovative content, techniques and ways of thinking. Through these posts you'll find lots of lesson ideas, teaching tips, resources and most importantly, inspiration.

feeds.title: Art Teacher in LA
feeds.description: K-8th grade art lessons by Maria Galloway. Blog posts on Art, Chalk art, Crayons, Drawing, Paining and Sculpting.

feeds.title: Expressive Monkey Blog
feeds.description: A place to go for inspiration, ideas, and easy-to-implement lessons for your art classroom. If you want to build your students' confidence in drawing, then these posts are for you!

feeds.title: Hipster Art Teacher Blog
feeds.description: Chelsey is certified to teach Art grades K-12 in NJ. She has taught at Southern Regional Middle and High Schools for the past two years as a long-term substitute.

feeds.title: Let's Build Great Things!
feeds.description: This blog is our Maker Journal about our experiences teaching annual workshops and weekly art and maker classes. We experiment with the maker curriculum and Project Based Learning adapted to urban South Asian kids.

feeds.title: Art with Mrs. Nguyen
feeds.description: An art education blog full of lessons, classroom management ideas and classroom decor resources. My name is Melinda and I'm an elementary art educator, a blogger, an instructional resource designer, an organization enthusiast and a jewelry creator.

feeds.title: Diary of a Mad Art Teacher... and photographer...
feeds.description: Diary of a Mad Art teacher and photographer featuring personal life stories, art stories, experiences, and more!

feeds.title: Betty's Blog
feeds.description: Betty Edwards is an American art teacher, lecturer, and author. The blog features articles depicting thoughts on drawing and creativity by Dr. Betty Edwards.

feeds.title: School of Atelier Arts Blog
feeds.description: The School of Atelier Arts teaches realistic drawing and painting skills to art teachers through our Department of Aesthetics Blog, the Ateliyay!

feeds.title: Mini Matisse
feeds.description: This blog is a conversation of how to teach our mini's. Contains articles on Art teaching, challenges, community events and Tips

feeds.title: Mrs. Knight's Smartest Artists
feeds.description: Fun art lessons by Mrs. Knight's Smartest Artists, Dolvin Elementary School, Johns Creek, Georgia.

feeds.title: Student Art Guide
feeds.description: The Student Art Guide helps students excel in a wide range of high school Art qualifications, such as IGCSE, GCSE, A Level, NCEA, AP Studio and IB Art. We compile new ideas, best practice and helpful learning strategies for high school Art students. Our website features outstanding high school art projects, including those that are awarded top in a qualification or country.

feeds.title: Art is Basic
feeds.description: My name is Marcia and I teach K-5 art at a small private school in Wisconsin. Through this blog, I share oodles of art project ideas, tips and tricks for managing the practical aspects of teaching art, and lots of inspiration from art & design.

feeds.title: Curated for Kids Blog
feeds.description: I'm Maria. Curated for Kids was borne from my desire to provide quality, age appropriate contemporary art images for my middle school art students as daily warm ups in class. The blog offers age-appropriate visual art content with suggestions for questions and prompts to consider during discussions with children.
